observations: 3 photos show a large truck-mounted borehole drilling rig (drilling mast/boom with hydraulic lines) on a white cab.
The rig appears mounted on a heavy-duty flatbed/rig frame with multiple hydraulic cylinders and hoses.
The truck front grille/badge area is visible but the exact make/model is not clearly readable in these images.
No clear readable plate/serial number/engine model is visible in the photos provided.
The machine is shown outdoors on uneven ground; no close-ups of key wear points (bit, rods, pump, gearbox) are provided.

claims.claim: Very sound and working fine borehole drilling machine
claims.evidence: Photos show the rig installed on a truck but do not show it operating (no running video, no drilling footage, no gauges/controls in use).
No on-site test results, commissioning report, or functional demonstration is shown.
This is marketing language; it does not provide verifiable technical condition details.

risks.risk: Engine/drivetrain and hydraulic system may not perform under load (leaks, weak hydraulics, overheating). Photos cannot confirm operational performance.
risks.proof: Short video of the rig running through key motions (mast/boom raise/lower, feed/rotation if applicable) plus a brief drilling attempt or hydraulic pressure reading on the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not proven working (treated like needs inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Missing/failed drilling consumables (bit, rods, casing, pump parts) or incomplete rig kit—photos don’t show the full set.
risks.proof: Clear inventory photos: bit, rods, swivel/hoses, pump unit, any casing accessories, and a checklist of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: incomplete/unknown kit (assume buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Unknown truck make/model, year, and service history affects value and parts cost.
risks.proof: Photo of the truck VIN/plate, engine number, and registration details; also odometer reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: unknown year/history (use conservative valuation for older/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Structural wear/damage to mast, frame, or welds (common on heavy rigs) cannot be assessed from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of mast joints, welds, cylinder mounting points, and any cracks/bent members (both sides).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: possible wear/damage requiring inspection/repairs.

risks.risk: Transport readiness and safety compliance (brakes, tires, electrics, lights) not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Photos of tires tread, brake lights, indicators, horn, and a short drive/engine start video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: may require immediate servicing for roadworthiness.

proof_requests: Video proof: rig operating (mast/boom movement + drilling/rotation/feeding if applicable) and any dashboard/pressure readings.
Close-up photos of: bit/rotary head, pump area, hydraulic cylinders/hoses, and any control panel labels.
Clear photos of truck identification: VIN/plate, engine number, registration details, and odometer.
Inventory list of included drilling accessories (bit, rods, casing, pump parts, hoses) with photos.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig, but they do not verify the seller’s key claim that it is working fine. Without operational proof and readable identification/service details, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
